purpose: Preserve exact merged source revisions while GitHub applies its configured head-branch deletion.
inputs: Current same-repository merged PR, matching original merged-event head, actual merge identity and time, current stable repository id, repository-scoped Actions token.
effects: Create refs/archive/<provider-merge-date>/<original-branch> only at the exact received PR head.
Read back the remote ref independently and retain the custody receipt on that merged PR.
Retain archive collisions and provider failures as visible blocked custody receiving.
prohibitions: No candidate checkout, code, package script, issue prose or artifact execution.
No branch deletion, rewrite of existing archive identity, personal credential, cross-repository credential or secret inheritance.
No source merge, authority grant, deployment or customer-acceptance claim.

design.source: Native pull refs provide independently checked original source identity, including squashed or already deleted heads.
design.planning: Existing metadata intake admits the merged event and checks repository identity before the archive effect.
design.execution: Fixed native Git commands, argument arrays, fresh bare object store, per-process repository token, exact empty-archive lease and independent readback.
design.receiving: Provider PR comment and workflow summary retain the exact archive, source and branch observations.

validation: Source and YAML parsing plus genuine hosted merged-PR archival required; no test suite as acceptance.
